title: Host Support Desk Guidance: Host Cancellations and Their Penalty
content:
# Desk Guidance — Host Cancellations and the Cancellation Penalty (Host Accounts)

## The rule

Every host cancellation of a confirmed stay is recorded against the host's Host Accounts record with its timing band. The band is fixed by the number of whole calendar days from the date of the cancellation to the stay's check-in date:

| Whole calendar days remaining to check-in | Timing band |
|---|---|
| 31 or more | More than 30 days |
| 2 to 30 | 30 days to 48 hours |
| 1 or fewer | Under 48 hours |

The penalty base is the cancelled stay's nightly subtotal, cleaning fee, pet fee total and extra-guest fee total. The penalty is the band's percentage of the base (rounded to the cent), raised to the lowest penalty when it is lower and cut to the highest penalty when it is higher, and it is recovered from the host's next payouts. The band percentages, the lowest penalty and the highest penalty are those of the host cancellation penalty schedule of Host Accounts.

## When no penalty is charged

- No penalty is charged when the cancellation was initiated by Roamhaven (Roamhaven cancelled the stay itself).
- No penalty is charged when a major disruptive event request on the stay has been approved under the Stays (Guest Reservations) rules.

## One penalty per cancelled stay

A penalty for the same cancelled stay is charged only once. A stay that already carries a penalty charge in the account's records is not charged again.

## Reasons given by the host

A penalty is never reduced at charging time for any reason the host gives. A documented reason is heard only through a penalty appeal under the penalty waiver rules of Host Accounts.

## Band boundaries (hypothetical check-in on 10 August)

| Date of the host cancellation | Whole days to check-in | Band |
|---|---|---|
| 10 July | 31 | More than 30 days |
| 11 July | 30 | 30 days to 48 hours |
| 8 August | 2 | 30 days to 48 hours |
| 9 August | 1 | Under 48 hours |

## Worked penalties (hypothetical bases, schedule figures of 10.00%, 25.00% and 50.00%, lowest USD 50.00, highest USD 1000.00)

| Penalty base | Band | Band percentage of the base | Penalty charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 900.00 | 30 days to 48 hours | USD 225.00 | USD 225.00 |
| USD 320.00 | More than 30 days | USD 32.00 | USD 50.00 (raised to the lowest penalty) |
| USD 2600.00 | Under 48 hours | USD 1300.00 | USD 1000.00 (cut to the highest penalty) |
| USD 900.00, cancellation initiated by Roamhaven | any | — | None |
